seo.title: Free analytics for your Discord bot
seo.description: Discord Analytics is a free, open source analytics dashboard for Discord bots. Add four lines to your discord.js, Oceanic or discord.py bot and see which commands land, where you're growing, and who sticks around.

hero.title: Know how your Discord bot is really used
hero.description: See which commands land, where you're growing, and who sticks around — in four lines of code.

integration.title: Four lines. That's the whole integration.
integration.description: Install the package, point it at your bot, and your dashboard starts filling up. No collectors to host, no schema to design, nothing to maintain.

install.title: Install the package
install.description: One dependency, from npm or PyPI.

integrate.title: Add four lines
integrate.description: Import it, pass your client and API token, then call init and trackEvents.

watch.title: Watch the stats land
watch.description: Commands, servers, users and votes appear in your dashboard as your bot runs.

docs.title: Using another library?
docs.description: Full setup guides for Oceanic and discord.py.

features.title: Everything you get, out of the box

teams.title: A collaborative platform
teams.description: Invite your teammates to access your bot's stats

graphs.title: A ton of graphs
graphs.description: Dozens of interactive graphs: user growth, command usage, server activity, and more.

votes.title: All your votes in one place
votes.description: Merge all your votes webhooks one

email.title: Email reports
email.description: Your stats summarised in your mailbox, weekly or monthly

achievements.title: Time to flex
achievements.description: Flex hard – craft unique achievements or grab fan-favorites from the Community Store.

custom_graphs.title: Your bot, your stats
custom_graphs.description: Create the graphs that fit the most your bot

community.title: Free because you keep it running
community.description: Discord Analytics is completely free and funded by your donations. The use of these funds is fully transparent thanks to public access to the transaction history.

1.question: Is Discord Analytics free?
1.answer: Yes, and as long as our costs allow it, Discord Analytics will remain completely free.

2.question: What languages and libraries does Discord Analytics support?
2.answer: Discord Analytics currently supports JavaScript and Python, and we are working on adding more languages and libraries.
2.link: See our documentation for more information.

3.question: How can I contact Discord Analytics?

answer.1: Our team is ready to answer your questions on our

4.question: What are the service limits?
4.answer: You can see you account limits in your account settings. The limits can be increased on request. To do so, please contact our team.

5.question: How can I contribute to Discord Analytics?
5.answer: Discord Analytics is Open Source, so you can contribute by making feature requests, bug reports, code pull requests or just by creating a donation on Open Collective!
